G2700.def: from «2596» and a derivative of «5115»; to shoot down with an arrow or other missile:--thrust through.

G2701.def: from «2596» and «5143»; to run down, i.e. hasten from a tower:--run down.

G2702.def: from «2596» and «5342» (including its alternate); to bear down, i.e. (figuratively) overcome (with drowsiness); specially, to cast a vote:--fall, give, sink down.

G2704.def: from «2596» and «5351»; to spoil entirely, i.e. (literally) to destroy; or (figuratively) to deprave; --corrupt, utterly perish.

G2706.def: from «2596» and «5426»; to think against, i.e. disesteem:--despise.

G2708.def: from «2596» and cheo (to pour); to pour down (out):--pour.

G2709.def: from «2596» and chthon (the ground); subterranean, i.e. infernal (belonging to the world of departed spirits):--under the earth.

G2710.def: from «2596» and «5530»; to overuse, i.e. misuse:--abuse.

G2711.def: from «2596» and «5594»; to cool down (off), i.e. refresh:--cool.

G2712.def: from «2596» (intensively) and «1497»; utterly idolatrous:--wholly given to idolatry.

G2713.def: from «2596» and «1725»; directly opposite:--before, over against.

G2714.def: from «2596» and «1799»; directly in front of:--before (the presence of), in the sight of.

G2715.def: from «2596» and «1850»; to have (wield) full privilege over:--exercise authority.

G2716.def: from «2596» and «2038»; to work fully, i.e. accomplish; by implication, to finish, fashion:--cause, to (deed), perform, work (out).

G2718.def: from «2596» and «2064» (including its alternate); to come (or go) down (literally or figuratively):--come (down), depart, descend, go down, land.

G2719.def: from «2596» and «2068» (including its alternate); to eat down, i.e. devour (literally or figuratively):--devour.

G2720.def: from «2596» and «2116»; to straighten fully, i.e. (figuratively) direct:--guide, direct.

G2721.def: from «2596» and «2186»; to stand over against, i.e. rush upon (assault):--make insurrection against.

G2722.def: from «2596» and «2192»; to hold down (fast), in various applications (literally or figuratively):--have, hold (fast), keep (in memory), let, × make toward, possess, retain, seize on, stay, take, withhold.

G2723.def: from «2725»; to be a plaintiff, i.e. to charge with some offence:--accuse, object.

G2724.def: from «2725»; a complaint ("category"), i.e. criminal charge:--accusation (X -ed).

G2725.def: from «2596» and «58»; against one in the assembly, i.e. a complainant at law; specially, Satan:--accuser.

G2726.et: from a compound of (2596) and perhaps a derivative of the base of (5316) (meaning downcast in look)
G2726.def: from a compound of «2596» and perhaps a derivative of the base of «5316» (meaning downcast in look); demureness, i.e. (by implication) sadness:--heaviness.

G2727.def: from «2596» and «2279»; to sound down into the ears, i.e. (by implication) to indoctrinate ("catechize") or (genitive case) to apprise of:--inform, instruct, teach.

G2728.def: from «2596» and a derivative of «2447»; to rust down, i.e. corrode:--canker.

G2730.def: from «2596» and «3611»; to house permanently, i.e. reside (literally or figuratively):--dwell(-er), inhabitant(-ter).

G2731.def: from «2730»; residence (properly, the act; but by implication, concretely, the mansion):--dwelling.

G2732.def: from a derivative of «2730»; a dwelling-place:--habitation.

G2733.def: residence (properly, the condition; but by implication, the abode itself):--habitation.

G2734.et: middle voice from a compound of (2596) and a derivative of (3700) [cf (2072)]
G2734.def: middle voice from a compound of «2596» and a derivative of «3700» (compare «2072»); to mirror oneself, i.e. to see reflected (figuratively):--behold as in a glass.

G2735.et: from a compound of (2596) and a derivative of (3717) [cf (1357)]
G2735.def: from a compound of «2596» and a derivative of «3717» (compare «1357»); something made fully upright, i.e. (figuratively) rectification (specially, good public administration):--very worthy deed.

G2736.def: (compare «2737»); adverb from «2596»; downwards:--beneath, bottom, down, under.

G2738.def: from «2545»; properly, a burn (concretely), but used (abstractly) of a glow:--heat.

G2741.def: from «2740»; to set on fire:--fervent heat.

G2743.def: from a derivative of «2545»; to brand ("cauterize"), i.e. (by implication) to render unsensitive (figuratively):--sear with a hot iron.

G2744.et: from some (obsolete) base akin to that of aucheo (to boast) and (2172)
G2744.def: from some (obsolete) base akin to that of aucheo (to boast) and «2172»; to vaunt (in a good or a bad sense):--(make) boast, glory, joy, rejoice.

G2745.def: from «2744»; a boast (properly, the object; by implication, the act) in a good or a bad sense:--boasting, (whereof) to glory (of), glorying, rejoice(-ing).

G2746.def: from «2744»; boasting (properly, the act; by implication, the object), in a good or a bad sense:--boasting, whereof I may glory, glorying, rejoicing.

G2747.def: probably from kegchros (millet); Cenchreae, a port of Corinth:--Cencrea.

G2748.def: of Hebrew origin («06939»); Cedron (i.e. Kidron), a brook near Jerusalem:--Cedron.

G2749.et: middle voice of a primary verb
G2749.def: middle voice of a primary verb; to lie outstretched (literally or figuratively):--be (appointed, laid up, made, set), lay, lie. Compare «5087».

G2750.def: of uncertain affinity; a swathe, i.e. winding-sheet:--graveclothes.

G2753.et: from a primary kello (to urge on)
G2753.def: from a primary kello (to urge on); "hail"; to incite by word, i.e. order:--bid, (at, give) command(-ment).

G2755.def: from «2756» and «1391»; vainly glorifying, i.e. self-conceited:--desirous of vain-glory.

G2756.def: apparently a primary word; empty (literally or figuratively):--empty, (in) vain.

G2757.et: from a presumed compound of (2756) and (5456)
G2757.def: from a presumed compound of «2756» and «5456»; empty sounding, i.e. fruitless discussion:--vain.

G2758.def: from «2756»; to make empty, i.e. (figuratively) to abase, neutralize, falsify:--make (of none effect, of no reputation, void), be in vain.

G2759.def: from kenteo (to prick); a point ("centre"), i.e. a sting (figuratively, poison) or goad (figuratively, divine impulse):--prick, sting.

G2760.def: of Latin origin; a centurion, i.e. captain of one hundred soldiers:--centurion.

G2761.def: adverb from «2756»; vainly, i.e. to no purpose:--in vain.

G2762.et: from a presumed derivative of the base of (2768)
G2762.def: feminine of a presumed derivative of the base of «2768»; something horn-like, i.e. (specially) the apex of a Hebrew letter (figuratively, the least particle):--tittle.

G2764.def: from «2766»; made of clay, i.e. earthen:--of a potter.

G2765.def: neuter of a presumed derivative of «2766»; an earthenware vessel, i.e. jar:--pitcher.

G2766.et: probably from the base of (2767) (through the idea of mixing clay and water)
G2766.def: probably from the base of «2767» (through the idea of mixing clay and water); earthenware, i.e. a tile (by analogy, a thin roof or awning):--tiling.

G2767.et: a prolonged form of a more primary kerao {ker-ah'-o} (which is used in certain tenses)
G2767.def: prolonged form of a more primary kerao ker-ah'-o (which is used in certain tenses); to mingle, i.e. (by implication) to pour out (for drinking):--fill, pour out. Compare «3396».

G2768.et: from a primary kar (the hair of the head)
G2768.def: from a primary kar (the hair of the head); a horn (literally or figuratively):--horn.

G2769.def: neuter of a presumed derivative of «2768»; something horned, i.e. (specially) the pod of the carob-tree:--husk.

G2770.def: from «2771»; to gain (literally or figuratively):--(get) gain, win.

G2771.def: of uncertain affinity; gain (pecuniary or genitive case):--gain, lucre.

G2772.def: from «2751»; a clipping (bit), i.e. (specially) a coin:--money.

G2773.def: from a derivative of «2772»; a handler of coins, i.e. money-broker:--changer of money.

G2774.def: neuter of a derivative of «2776»; a principal thing, i.e. main point; specially, an amount (of money):--sum.

G2775.def: from the same as «2774»; (specially) to strike on the head:--wound in the head.

G2776.et: from the primary kapto (in the sense of seizing)
G2776.def: from the primary kapto (in the sense of seizing); the head (as the part most readily taken hold of), literally or figuratively:--head.

G2777.def: from «2776»; properly, a knob, i.e. (by implication) a roll (by extension from the end of a stick on which the manuscript was rolled):--volume.

G2778.def: of Latin origin; properly, an enrollment ("census"), i.e. (by implication) a tax:--tribute.

G2780.def: from «2779» and ouros (a warden); a garden-keeper, i.e. gardener:--gardener.

G2781.def: diminutive from keos (wax); a cell for honey, i.e. (collectively) the comb:--(honey-)comb.

G2782.def: from «2784»; a proclamation (especially of the gospel; by implication, the gospel itself):--preaching.

G2783.def: from «2784»; a herald, i.e. of divine truth (especially of the gospel):--preacher.

G2784.def: of uncertain affinity; to herald (as a public crier), especially divine truth (the gospel):--preacher(-er), proclaim, publish.

G2785.def: probably from the base of «5490»; a huge fish (as gaping for prey):--whale.

G2786.def: of Chaldee origin (compare «03710»); the Rock; Cephas (i.e. Kepha), a surname of Peter:--Cephas.

G2787.def: of uncertain derivation; a box, i.e. the sacred ark and that of Noah:--ark.

G2789.def: from «2788»; to play on a lyre:--harp.

G2790.et: from (2788) and a derivative of the same as (5603)
G2790.def: from «2788» and a derivative of the same as «5603»; a lyre-singer(-player), i.e. harpist:--harper.

G2791.def: probably of foreign origin; Cilicia, a region of Asia Minor:--Cilicia.

G2793.def: from «2794»; to undergo peril:--be in danger, be (stand) in jeopardy.

G2795.et: from kio (poetic for eimi, to go)
G2795.def: from kio (poetic for eimi, to go); to stir (transitively), literally or figuratively:--(re-)move(-r), way.

G2797.def: of Hebrew origin («07027»); Cis (i.e. Kish), an Israelite:--Cis.

G2799.def: of uncertain affinity; to sob, i.e. wail aloud (whereas 1145 is rather to cry silently):--bewail, weep.
